name: THE DAY IS AT HAND
text: For the turning point, whenever a friendly Wyrmblade operative is activated and its order is switched from Conceal to Engage, until the end of that activation its ranged weapons have Rending and its melee weapons get +1 Atk (never above 5).

name: CROSSFIRE
text: For the turning point, when a friendly Wyrmblade operative shoots an enemy that a different friendly Wyrmblade operative has already shot this turning point, the shooter's ranged weapons have Accurate 1.

name: ONE WITH THE SHADOWS
text: For the turning point, when an operative shoots a friendly Wyrmblade operative with a Conceal order, intervening Light terrain makes the target obscured, unless that Light terrain is within 1 inch of either operative.

name: DIVERT AND DISAPPEAR
text: Up to three friendly Wyrmblade operatives, one at a time, make a free Dash or a free Charge (the Charge up to 3 inches). A Cult Agent counts as two of the three and may instead make a free Fall Back of up to 3 inches, in which case it has -1 APL until the end of its next activation.

name: SLINK INTO DARKNESS
text: At the end of a friendly Wyrmblade operative's activation, if it has an Engage order, change it to Conceal. You can choose each friendly operative for this only once per battle.

name: COILED SERPENT
text: When a friendly Wyrmblade operative shoots or fights, after you roll your attack dice: if its order was switched from Conceal to Engage at the start of this activation and this is its first Shoot or Fight of the activation, keep one normal success as a critical success. Once per activation.

name: UNQUESTIONING LOYALTY
text: When a friendly Cult Agent or Leader is chosen as the target of a Shoot or as the opponent in a Fight, pick another friendly Neophyte (not the Leader) that can see and is within 3 inches of it; that Neophyte becomes the target or opponent instead, even if it would not normally qualify. In a Fight it counts as in the fighter's control range; in a Shoot it is in cover or obscured only if the original target was. No effect against Blast or Torrent weapons.

name: A PLAN GENERATIONS IN THE MAKING
text: When a friendly Wyrmblade Neophyte is incapacitated, before it is removed it can make one free mission action.
